title: Pinions on opposite faces
question: Drive A CW. Determine the motion of B (spin) and C (spin) at the shown instant. Use the labeled contact views.

answer.explanation: Drive A CW. At the tooth section the two rim tangents must coincide. The marked CW tangents agree. A positive, B positive. At the tooth section the two rim tangents must coincide. The marked CW tangents oppose one another. A positive, C negative. The requested motion is CW / CCW (in listed output order).

options.label: A
options.explanation: C must be CCW. At the tooth section the two rim tangents must coincide. The marked CW tangents oppose one another. A positive, C negative..

options.label: B
options.explanation: All requested motions agree with the contact constraints.

options.label: C
options.explanation: B must be CW. At the tooth section the two rim tangents must coincide. The marked CW tangents agree. A positive, B positive.. C must be CCW. At the tooth section the two rim tangents must coincide. The marked CW tangents oppose one another. A positive, C negative..
